notes: TBox expansion, paired with geography-replace-0005. Keeps the revision's relation (has_midnight_sun_in) and new object (winter) and gives them to a made-up class (the skerrane, a newly described kind of islet group) under the real class of islet groups, so no old value is pushed out and the real rule for places north of the Arctic Circle is untouched. The derived queries name invented islets (Orrowick, Vennisgard, Halbrae) with the class stated in the prompt (inheritance, 2 hops, bridge in the prompt): the inserted rule is their only route. The third is an application (a photographer's trip plan). Near unrelated: the real season of Tromso's midnight sun, which must stay 'summer' (a bare 'midnight sun -> winter' mapping would leak there); the class is not placed in any real region. Names are invented; the evidence records that they are absent from the corpus. Side facts and checks are those of the paired revision.
